payload.tension: The passage states genesis 7:20–24 places spirit language at the boundary of life and death, where it is locally described; the immediate wording centers on “In whose nostrils was the breath of the spirit of life.” It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Spirit.
